name: claude-hpc-kit
description: Let Claude Code run, watch and debug jobs on your own compute clusters

plugins.name: hpc
plugins.description: Skills and a small CLI that let Claude copy code to your clusters, submit Slurm or PBS jobs, watch them and pull results back

plugins.name: compute-pane
plugins.description: A read-only pane that lists your Slurm and PBS jobs on the sites in the hpc site registry
